The '''Palarians''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pal Goral]].

They were often recruited to work on the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] world of [[Duroon]]. Once there, however, the promised jobs turned out to be a position of near-[[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], and the Palarians were forced to [[Mining/Legends|mine]] the planet's vast resources alongside other indentured species. The Palarians did not take this turn of events laying down, and started a guerrilla war against the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].
